files.rationale: Parent settings model stores npm/git package sources inside the extensions array and exposes getExtensionPaths/setExtensionPaths. Introducing a dedicated packages configuration with selective resource filters and migration from npm:/git: entries requires changing this settings surface while preserving local extension behaviour.

DefaultPackageManager.resolve currently treats extensions entries as the installable npm/git/local sources and materialises extensions/skills/prompts/themes paths. Dedicated package configuration and selective package resource loading must be implemented here while keeping local resource resolution consistent.

CLI package install/remove/list currently normalises npm:/git: sources and mutates settings.extensions. Needed to keep package-management behaviour consistent after packages are separated from local extensions.
Existing settings-manager tests on the parent snapshot establish current settings load/save behaviour that must remain intact when packages migration and package getters/setters are added.
Public exports for SettingsManager and package-manager types; relevant for preserving package API surface after PackageSource is introduced.
